Warlord Dar'toon is an orc quest giver found at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands. He stands studying the map of Outland laid out on the table in front of him with Watch Commander Relthorn Netherwane and Advisor Sevel, two Alliance officers who are neutral to the Horde. He sent Horde members through the Dark Portal to Outland on the other side to meet Lieutenant General Orion for further instructions. It's unknown what happened with him when the Ironmarch attacked.

Warlord Salaris is one of the 8 different NPCs that can be with Priestess Delrissa, the third boss in Magisters' Terrace. He is a naga warrior. He hits hard and should either be crowd-controlled for the whole fight or killed quickly. He seems to have a slightly larger aggro radius than the rest of the group. Beware getting too close. He is crowd-controllable.

Warlord Zim'bo is an ice troll found in Zim'bo's Hideout of Zeb'Halak in Grizzly Hills. Drakuru wants you to slay him and collect his mojo.
__NOTOC__ Warlord Tartek is a wolvar found in Sholazar Basin.
__NOTOC__ Warlord Zol'Maz is an ice troll located in Zul'Drak.
Warlord Hork Strongbrow is, according to himself, dying. He was rescued out from the Broken Front by Argent Crusade agents.
Warlord Wrathspine is a naga located inside the cave of Nazj'vel, in southern Darkshore.

Warlord Torok is an orc quest giver initially located at the Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest. However, he will relocate, along with Admiral Hatchet, to the Sepulcher, where Sylvanas Windrunner personally oversees the Horde war effort. Torok's Orc Sea Dogs are not the most competent troops. He apparently needs to send them into battle with an adequate supply of liquor or they will fare poorly, as was the case at the Decrepit Fields. He is ultimately seen fighting worgen in The Battlefront.
Warlord Roktrog appears on accepting Rumble in the Lumber... Mill. He doesn't re-spawn unless you drop the quest and get it again.

__NOTOC__ The Warmaul of Burningeye is a common archaeology artifact requiring 45 Dwarf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to two Dwarf Rune Stone keystones may be used to aid in solving this artifact.

Warlord Krogg is an orc initially located in Bilgewater Harbor who is part of the introductory quest for the Twilight Highlands. He later resides in that zone. He is the leader of the Axebite, an orc military group. Garrosh Hellscream sends players to Krogg as part of the breadcrumb quests for the Twilight Highlands, and Krogg will have players help with the personnel issues he has been having of late. In Bilgewater Harbor, he will say different things depending on the level of the character. After the Twilight Highlands intro quest, he resides at the Krazzworks, but also appears for the assault on Grim Batol.

Warlord Zon'ozz is the second boss (or third if Yor'sahj the Unsleeping is killed first) to appear in the Dragon Soul raid. World first heroic kill on 25-man achieved 6.12.2011 by Blood Legion - US-Illidan.

The Warmace of Taran Zhu is the weapon of Taran Zhu, Lord of the Shado-Pan. He uses the weapon in conjunction with unarmed attacks like most monks. Taran is shown using the mace during the Siege of Orgrimmar Patch 5.4.0 trailer, using it to disarm Garrosh Hellscream.
Warlord Gurthan is a mogu spirit that can be summoned at the Terrace of Gurthan in the Dread Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Warlord Ihsenn is a human located at the Ruins of Ahmtul in Uldum. He is the ring leader of the Wastewander Bandits in the area.
__NOTOC__ Warmaul Chef Bufferlo is an ogre located at the Warmaul Hill in Nagrand.
Warlord Jin'arrak is an ice troll ghost located at the Drakil'jin Ruins in Grizzly Hills. He is summoned back from the dead during Jin'arrak's End.
Warlord Bult is the overseer of the operations at the Circle of Blood within Frostfire Ridge. Igrim the Resolute seeks his death, along with the rest of the ogre leadership at the Circle of Blood.

Warlord Dharl of the Thrice-Bloodied Blade was an orc blademaster, the Warlord of the , and the father of Azuka Bladefury. He is killed after an adventurer and kill his son Luhk and grandsons and Sesk. After his death, Azuka claimed the title of Warlord.

Warlords Arena Season 1 (or Arena Season 16) is a PvP season that began three weeks after the launch of Warlords of Draenor, on December 2nd, 2014. It ended when patch 6.2.0 was released. The season lasted for 29 weeks.

The World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor Soundtrack was composed by Russell Brower, Neal Acree, Clint Bajakian, Sam Cardon, Craig Stuart Garfinkle, Edo Guidotti and Eimear Noone. It was released together with the collector's edition of the game. It can be also be purchased via Itunes.

Warlords Arena Season 3 (or Arena Season 18) is a PvP season that began one week after the launch of patch 6.2.2, on November 17, 2015. It ended with the launch of patch 7.0.3. The season lasted 35 weeks.

Warlord Parjesh is a naga boss located at the Hatecoil Encampment in Eye of Azshara. After the shards of the Tidestone of Golganneth were collected by a brave hero, Parjesh and Athissa stole it and tried to bring it to Queen Azshara. As a top warlord, Parjesh wears the grandest armor the naga can produce, his hauberk being one of legend.
Warlord Volund is a vrykul located at the Tomb of the Old Kings in Stormheim.

Warlord Breka Grimaxe is an orc found in Exile's Reach and later she can be found in Hall of Legends at Orgrimmar. She leads an expedition to find her daughter Shuja Grimaxe and her force that had gone missing, training new Horde recruits and dealing with the threat of the Darkmaul ogres and their minions in the process. At some point, she fought with Captain Garrick against the Scourge, becoming acquainted enough to call each other honorable and to share drinks. She and her daughter join up with the Dragonscale Expedition and can be found at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores. Breka and Shuja were present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
The Warm Seaweed Stalk is found amongst electric seaweed in the fatigue waters of Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.
